title: Launcher direct-core routing for critical commands
title_ko: 런처 크리티컬 명령 Core 직접 라우팅
desc: Commands like suggest, skill, eye bypass normal launcher pipe and route directly to Core for reliability.
steps: Critical commands (suggest, skill, eye) route directly to Core process bypassing the Launcher IPC pipe to avoid deadlocks.
Direct routing: Launcher detects critical commands and spawns Core with DETACHED_PROCESS + direct stdio instead of pipe relay.
Why: pipe relay has IOCP overhead and ConPTY LPC deadlock risk. Direct Core ensures commands complete even when Eye is unhealthy.
author: claude
